726950.cdNote: This is a role-playing game in which players join young soldiers battling monsters and trying to save the world. As players explore a futuristic alternate universe, they engage in turn-based combat with beasts called Chimera. Characters use sword-gun weapons to deplete enemies' health meters; combat is highlighted by realistic gunfire, light effects, and cries of pain. One cutscene contains still images of a character repeatedly shooting another with a pistol; a pool of blood is depicted afterwards. The game includes some suggestive imagery: a beach scene in which female characters are provocatively posed in swimsuits that reveal deep cleavage; a hot-spring sequence in which women appear partially topless. The dialogue briefly mentions illicit drugs (e.g., “[I]llegal, sweetly flavored drugs are popular lately...” and “Recently there have been rumors of drug trafficking...”). The words “sh*t” and “a*shole” appear in dialogue.
726950.desc: 西暦1929年、突如として大勢の人々が人ならざる者【キメラ】に変化する怪現象が発生する。 原因は過去に落下した、通称【ブラックガーネット】と呼ばれる隕石がもたらした未知のウイルスによるものだった。 【キメラウイルス】と名付けられたウイルスは世界的パンデミックを引き起こし、人類は総人口の3%を失う事となる。 この非常事態に国は“鎖国”という方針をとり外部からのウイルス侵入を遮断、更に国内に残るキメラ迎撃のため【特務機関ACID】が組織される。 そして時は流れ、特務機関ACIDは今なお人を脅かすキメラを撲滅する為、特殊部隊ワルキューレを創設する。

733340.cdNote: This is an interactive story game (i.e., visual novel) in which players assume the role of a girl searching for her father in 19th century Japan. Players progress through the story, interact with samurai and demon characters, and watch events as they unfold. Some events lead to sequences of violence; these still-frame scenes depict characters slashing each other with swords, and are sometimes accompanied by cries of pain and splashes of blood. Bloodstains are also depicted on characters' bodies and clothing. Violence is sometimes described in the text (e.g., “Okita was struck in his bicep, and blood flowed freely from the wound, spilling onto the ground below.”). The game includes some suggestive material in text (e.g., “He moved his hands nervously to the top of my blouse, taking his time to undo each of the buttons...”; “[A] figure of propriety and class, was the last person I'd ever expect to force himself onto me…”). The words “f**k” and “sh*t” appear in the dialogue.

This game features mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences, including:
cartoon/fantasy violence; blood; violent acts; accidental death; bodily injury; corpses; violence description; killing; depiction of self-harm; fear; mild swearing/profanity; censored nudity; alcohol or tobacco consumption.

For those who may feel discomfort regarding the listed topic(s), please refrain from playing the game.

Explanation regarding some topics listed above:

1. Cartoon/fantasy violence; blood; violent acts; bodily injury; corpses; violence description; killing; depiction of self-harm; fear
As a core part of the narrative and gameplay experience, Sign: Broken Kether contains depictions of violence, murder scenes, self-harm, and dark themes. While some violent depictions appear as text descriptions or stylized visual representations, certain scenes during key story developments are presented directly to convey the narrative atmosphere. However, violence and gore are primarily presented through stylized, artistic imagery without the use of jump scare tactics, aiming to maintain the game’s dramatic tone while minimizing pure psychological shock.

2. Censored nudity; alcohol or tobacco consumption; mild swearing
The game contains partial/censored nudity in specific story contexts, as well as character depictions involving alcohol consumption, tobacco use, and mild profanity. These elements are designed purely for character development and world-building within the fictional setting.

4175050.cdNote: First-person psychological horror game. The player is hunted by a blade-wielding killer and can be attacked and killed, including while hiding. Attacks are violent but show no explicit blood, and no dismemberment is shown on screen; death cuts straight to a black screen. At one point a severed head is shown, though the act of cutting it off is never depicted. 4675840.cdNote: Deep Frost is a single-player psychological horror game set in an isolated, failing Antarctic research station. Crew members die during a run: the crew can vote to burn a suspect with a flamethrower, people are killed overnight, and some die when station systems fail. These deaths happen off-screen and are described in short text reports with sound effects. No bodies, blood or gore are shown as images. Short text death reports describe frozen bodies in brief, graphic terms, for example skin split along the spine or a throat frosted shut. One in-game archive page briefly describes a failed copy in body-horror terms. Themes include isolation, paranoia, mistrust, and a body-snatcher antagonist that copies members of the crew. There are no chase sequences or creature jumpscares, but each overnight death is announced with a sudden loud sound sting and a brief red screen pulse; the Reduced flashes setting turns off the red pulse and a rare one-frame glitch. No sexual content and no drug use.
4675840.desc: 破綻しつつある南極基地を舞台にした一人用ソーシャル推理ホラー。隊員に問いただし、食い違う証言を突き合わせ、投票の前に誰を告発するか、誰を弁護するか決める。弁護した人物に欺かれるかもしれない。

4741650.cdNote:
Make A Racket contains mature themes and content, including violence, strong language, illegal drugs, alcohol, criminal activity and dark humour.

Players can use firearms and other weapons against NPCs. Combat is non-lethal and does not feature blood or death, but due to the nature of the game's operation, death might be implied. Defeated NPCs are knocked unconscious and return to the world the following day or despawn to reappear another day. Some violent interactions are exaggerated for comedic effect.

Drug-related content is a significant part of the game. Players can produce, buy, sell and distribute illegal drugs as part of building their criminal operation. Drugs are not currently consumable by the player. There is also currently no visible drug use in the game.

The game deals with these subjects primarily through satire, parody and dark comedy, but players should be aware that mature and potentially sensitive themes are present throughout.

5096450.cdNote:
For My Kingdom is a narrative-driven card game about ruling a medieval kingdom.
Its mature content is entirely thematic. As king you make harsh decisions
involving execution, torture, slavery and death in war, but none of it is shown
on screen and everything is conveyed through text. Some portraits are painted in
a realistic style and include bloodstains and wounded faces. Wine trade and
drinking at court feasts are recurring themes. The game also deals with the
religious tensions of the era. Treating other faiths with tolerance or
intolerance is the player's choice, and every choice carries a cost that the
kingdom bears. There is no nudity, sexual content, drugs or gambling.

5159930.cdNote:
本作は借金と取り立てを題材にした、ダークな世界観のゲームです。以下の要素を含みます。

・模擬賭博の描写
運の要素を含むゲーム機（クレーンゲーム、確率抽選によるルーレット機能）を操作し、ゲーム内通貨を増やすことがプレイの中心です。実在の賭博を再現するものではなく、現金や現金で購入する通貨は一切使用しません。ゲーム内の通貨やアイテムに現実的な価値はなく、現金と交換することもできません。

・犯罪行為の描写
不正に得た資金の洗浄、および金融機関の送金への不正アクセスによる資金の奪取が、ゲーム内の手段として登場します。これらはフィクションであり、現実での実行を推奨するものではありません。

・多額の負債と、その取り立て
返済不能に陥ると悪魔による取り立てを受け、ゲームオーバーとなります。精神的な圧迫感を伴う演出が含まれます。

・悪魔、オカルトを題材とした表現
悪魔をモチーフとしたキャラクターや演出が登場します。

・激しい光の明滅
特定の演出で画面が激しく明滅します。光過敏性発作の既往がある方はご注意ください。

本作には、性的表現、ヌード、流血・ゴア表現、薬物やアルコールの乱用、自傷行為の描写は含まれていません。
5159930.desc: 一部屋だけで完結する一人用ローグライク・ギャンブル。 多額の借金を返すため、クレーンゲームで元手を掴み、ミニゲームで賭けて増やし、ATMでコインを換金する。 稼いだ金で設備を強化し、タイプライターでスキルを磨け。 鳴り響くインターホン。訪ねてくるのは、あなたを食い物にする者か、それとも悪魔に牙を剥く者か。 どの取引に乗り、どう会話を運ぶか。その判断こそが、この部屋から出られるかどうかを決める。
